method: Read-only inspection of listed source files; no physical Mac, provider, Docker, wallet, RPC or payment operation.

findings.implemented: Bundled artifacts pin AGIJobManager v1.1.0 source commit db876a8021da6afcf7aa974489d13374e6d188b5. Enrollment checks deployment creation block, manager plus eight linked-library runtimes, native USDC and six decimals; verification rechecks deployed code identities.
findings.gap: Distributed defaults have manager empty and deploymentBlock zero. The actual operator-selected chain/address/block/bytecode/token/ABI observations were not available in this review. Do not infer an actual deployment from the default chain ID or Fleet version.

findings.implemented: SQLite job IDs and transactional cursors provide durable ingestion. Confirmed/finalized heights are bounded. Stored cursor hash mismatch stops for reindex/reconciliation.
findings.gap: Reorganization and interruption behavior needs evidence against the selected deployment and a capable environment; a fail-closed reindex requirement is not automatic recovery.

findings.implemented: Signed transactions are durably reserved before broadcast. Recovery follows the known transaction hash/nonce, verifies receipts and finality, and refuses silent duplicate replacement. Current policy is rechecked before rebroadcast.
findings.gap: No actual funded job, independent acceptance, settlement receipt or interrupted live-transaction recovery was performed here.

findings.implemented: Role allowlists distinguish Employer funding/acceptance/dispute, Agent application/submission, Node validation, Moderator appointed dispute decisions, read-only Evidence, and bounded Recovery finalization/expiry/refund/claims.
findings.gap: All-six-role discovery-through-archive qualification remains pending. The internal Creator/Checker/Reviewer workflow is not independent acceptance.

findings.implemented: SQLite queues, atomic admission/funding reservations, unique capacity leases, reviewer windows, bounded retries, account locks, run journals and native heartbeat leases exist. Agent/reviewer capacity is included in Employer reservations.
findings.gap: These primitives do not establish a qualified distributed queue or measured fleet throughput. Partitioned leases, backpressure under load, restart recovery, reviewer saturation and long-running resource consumption still need scenario evidence.

findings.implemented: Review-time policy rejects duplicate participant wallets/controllers/failure domains/keys. Workforce qualification requires distinct declared organizations and keys and held-out observed outcomes.
findings.gap: Declarations, signatures, different wallets and different process names do not prove organizational independence. Record assignment, conflicts, actual controllers and evidence supporting each decision.

findings.implemented: Append-only durable starts/finishes, start hashes, allowlisted classifications, exact-session inventory and process-termination/postcondition checks preserve uncertain outcomes and block work. Existing cleanup history survives restart.
findings.gap: The original physical-Mac failure root cause remains unobserved here. A zero-attempt or ABSENT inventory is not a live cleanup pass. Base/browser and observer/workspace stages must be exercised after the signer correction.

findings.implemented: Repair preserves COMPUTE_STOP and historical evidence and does not automatically clear safety stops.
findings.gap: A reviewed bounded reconciliation operation that validates retained evidence and restores authority was not implemented in this signer-only change. Do not remove markers or delete evidence manually.

findings.implemented: Inventory exposes observed attempt count and byte count. The enforced bounds are 4096 attempts and 16777216 bytes; new intent reserves space for pending finishes.
findings.gap: No verified archival/rotation chain or proactive capacity-warning workflow exists in the inspected runtime. Saturation remains fail-closed. Runtime identity must not be silently changed to address this during the signer-only correction.

findings.implemented: Twenty-four reusable case specifications cover software, numerical reproduction, public data, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, isolated browser and dedicated native desktop workflows.
findings.gap: These are specifications only: zero cases were executed by this qualification work; deliverables, acceptance, costs and payments remain unmeasured. No commercial receipts or throughput results are claimed.
